hook: Your safari in Gujarat can show lions found nowhere else in the wild.
title: The Only Place on Earth With Wild Asiatic Lions
description:
Gir forest in Gujarat is the only place on Earth where wild Asiatic lions live. They are a different subspecies from African lions. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #GirForest #IndiaFacts
